brief.aim: No column is a plausible outcome and rows are transactional events, so the defensible aim is to segment customers/transactions into natural groups via clustering, grouping rows by CustomerID and leaving timestamps out of partitioning since they are used only to aggregate static features.
brief.repeated_subjects: CustomerID repeats: the same customer appears on many invoice line rows, so all rows of a customer must stay in one partition
brief.unit: one invoice line item (a product quantity on an invoice)
